principle: minimal deterministic edits; never change numbers, units, citations or hedging strength

status.success: polished text produced; no rejected edit, terminology drift or terminology conflict
status.partial: polished text produced but some edit was rejected or terminology drift/conflict remains
status.insufficient_input: no text of at least 20 characters was found

discipline.edit_scope: surface minimal edits and declared terminology only
discipline.rejected_edits: recorded with reason, never silently dropped
discipline.style_rewriting: not attempted when target_style is unspecified
